partner_json_extract.hero: Noon × Navier — commerce and concierge logistics, now on the water
partner_json_extract.why_now: The UAE is concentrating residential, tourism, restaurant, hotel, and event demand on waterfront districts while marine mobility is being actively modernized. Navier adds a fast, smooth, low-noise foiling layer that uses existing water and berth infrastructure, so Noon can extend its app-native convenience from roads to the coast without waiting for new land corridors.
partner_json_extract.multimodal_fit: Noon already manages demand aggregation, order surfaces, payments, fulfillment expectations, and customer communication. Navier becomes the premium marine segment behind selected delivery, send, concierge, hospitality, and experience products.
partner_json_extract.differentiation: {'why_navier': 'Software-defined, autonomy-ready foiling vessels with a network playbook that can be routed, sealed, QA’d, and exported through the Atlas/Grok deterministic loop.'}
partner_json_extract.the_ask: Approve the Noon skeleton for Grok seal/QA: derive final scope city IDs and route IDs from the shared spine, keep KSA/Egypt as narrative scope only, and cascade economics only after route IDs are sealed.
partner_json_extract.close: Noon can own the UAE water layer as commerce infrastructure — starting with exact Atlas geometry and no invented routes.
